How the platform responds: The step list marks every block as done, current or locked, with an "X of Y complete" badge that updates as steps are finished
Class cards follow the Canvas course-card pattern most users already know
Deleting a block needs a second click within three seconds, which prevents accidental loss without a pop-up
The three themes are built from one component set and one token system
Changing a password in Settings requires the current password, and a sign-up request stays a request, with no account, until an admin approves it
Every nested page shows a breadcrumb
Create lesson from inside a subject pre-fills the class and subject
The admin home page was redesigned around the actions an admin needs next
The worksheet generator reports a source it cannot read and still completes the rest
The settings menu links to the design record and the worksheet generator specification
